content.short: Cwallet is a versatile multi-chain wallet known for its powerful SocialFi tools and tipping bots on Telegram.
content.description: Cwallet (formerly CCWallet) is a unique multi-chain wallet that combines centralized and decentralized features to provide a comprehensive digital asset experience. It is particularly well-known for its innovative SocialFi tools, including multi-functional tipping bots and airdrop management systems for Telegram and Discord. Cwallet supports TON and dozens of other blockchains, making it a favorite for community managers and social media users who want to engage their audience with crypto rewards. It provides a secure and highly interactive way to manage and distribute digital assets.
content.meta: Experience SocialFi with Cwallet. Multi-chain storage and social tipping bots on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
